notes.title: Patched the Patch
notes.notes: Fixed bug where cloud projectile size is too big and couldn't be used on bar roof.

notes.title: First Patch!
notes.notes:
Lots of little and big bugs found since release! Here's the list of fixes.

Fixed a bug where you weren't able to get the Defeat Mud Boss Achievement.

Fixed bug where Ice and Cloud Parkour Health pickups and some extra pickups were already collected (May be able to collect extra health pickups if new save file isn't made. Shouldn't affect anything.)

Fixed bug where you could shoot projectiles through walls. This included cloud allowing you to phase through walls and get out of bounds.

Added taskbar icon for the game instead of Unreal icon.

Mud can no longer stick to fulcrum.

Bug where infinite jumping cheat unlockable works in time trials when it should be disabled.

Fixed bug where walking through or shooting croquet hoops disabled the ability for the croquet ball to activate them.

Centered Keybinds button for easier view.

Cheat turbo button no longer gets unbound when loading.

Fixed bug with projectiles getting stuck inside two way pipes.

notes.title: Droplette Released!
notes.notes:
Hello, creator of the game here! Just wanted to make a post here since the game has been released. I wanted to say for those who have gotten the game I would love it if you reached out to me if you have any critiques or bugs that you find during the game! As of right now it seems like it's going pretty smoothly though which is awesome! My discord server is https://discord.gg/K4dj6RT or if you want to dm me directly its rivero7462.

Currently one minor bug has been found where you don't obtain the achievement for beating the boss at the end of the game. I will be adding a patch in a few days if nothing else noteworthy comes in, so expect to see another post here when that has been fixed!

Other than that, I hope you all enjoy playing my first steam game! I've worked really hard this past year to get it to where it is now.

Thank you!
Alex
